stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (fall 2025 first-time first-year): 11,119 applied, 10,474 admitted (94%); international 1,016 applied, 951 admitted (94%), 27 enrolled. The GPA breakdown is the 'all enrolled students' column. The shares who sent scores come from the counts (117 SAT, 1,176 ACT) out of the 2,519 enrolled; only those submitters are in the score percentiles, so the percentiles run higher than the whole class because UAB is test-optional for applicants with a 3.5+ GPA. The admission factor check boxes were unreadable in the PDF text, so admission factors are not shown. Undergraduate enrollment is 12,100 and there are 336 nonresident undergraduates (fall 2025).

cost.notes: First-year costs for 2026-27 from the Common Data Set: in-state $11,970, out-of-state $29,820, nonresident (international) $32,490; required fees $500; on-campus food and housing $14,720. Tuition varies by program. The Common Data Set shows 189 nonresident undergraduates received institutional aid, average $18,850 (total $3,562,740); its text does not show whether the aid was need-based or non-need-based
